Claret-Bruno longitudinal model with subject-level covariates

Source: R/LongitudinalClaretBrunoCov.R
LongitudinalClaretBrunoCov-class.Rd

Separate covariate predictors model the log-normal distribution parameters for baseline tumour size, growth, resistance, and growth inhibition.

Formula intercept columns are removed because every predictor has a separate intercept. Predictor parametrizations have the same meaning as in LongitudinalSteinFojoCov().

Usage

LongitudinalClaretBrunoCov(
  mu_b_formula = ~study,
  omega_b_formula = ~study,
  mu_g_formula = ~arm,
  omega_g_formula = ~arm,
  mu_c_formula = ~arm,
  omega_c_formula = ~arm,
  mu_p_formula = ~arm,
  omega_p_formula = ~arm,
  mu_b_parametrization = "linear",
  omega_b_parametrization = "log-linear",
  mu_g_parametrization = "linear",
  omega_g_parametrization = "log-linear",
  mu_c_parametrization = "linear",
  omega_c_parametrization = "log-linear",
  mu_p_parametrization = "linear",
  omega_p_parametrization = "log-linear",
  mu_b_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(60), 1),
  mu_b_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  omega_b_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(0.2), 1),
  omega_b_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  mu_g_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(1), 1),
  mu_g_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  omega_g_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(0.2), 1),
  omega_g_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  mu_c_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(0.4), 1),
  mu_c_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  omega_c_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(0.2), 1),
  omega_c_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  mu_p_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(2), 1),
  mu_p_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  omega_p_intercept_prior = prior_normal(log(0.2), 1),
  omega_p_coefficients_prior = prior_normal(0, 1),
  sigma = prior_lognormal(log(0.1), 1),
  scaled_variance = FALSE,
  centred_baseline = TRUE,
  centred_growth = FALSE,
  centred_resistance = FALSE,
  centred_inhibition = FALSE
)

Arguments

mu_b_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the baseline tumour size mean.

omega_b_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the baseline tumour size standard deviation.

mu_g_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the growth mean.

omega_g_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the growth standard deviation.

mu_c_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the resistance mean.

omega_c_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the resistance standard deviation.

mu_p_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the growth inhibition mean.

omega_p_formula

(formula) One-sided formula for subject-level covariate effects on the growth inhibition standard deviation.

mu_b_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the baseline tumour size mean predictor.

omega_b_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the baseline tumour size standard deviation predictor. Only "exponential" and "log-linear" are supported.

mu_g_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the growth mean predictor.

omega_g_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the growth standard deviation predictor. Only "exponential" and "log-linear" are supported.

mu_c_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the resistance mean predictor.

omega_c_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the resistance standard deviation predictor. Only "exponential" and "log-linear" are supported.

mu_p_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the growth inhibition mean predictor.

omega_p_parametrization

(character) Parametrization of the growth inhibition standard deviation predictor. Only "exponential" and "log-linear" are supported.

mu_b_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the baseline tumour size mean predictor.

mu_b_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the baseline tumour size mean predictor.

omega_b_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the baseline tumour size standard deviation predictor.

omega_b_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the baseline tumour size standard deviation predictor.

mu_g_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the growth mean predictor.

mu_g_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the growth mean predictor.

omega_g_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the growth standard deviation predictor.

omega_g_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the growth standard deviation predictor.

mu_c_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the resistance mean predictor.

mu_c_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the resistance mean predictor.

omega_c_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the resistance standard deviation predictor.

omega_c_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the resistance standard deviation predictor.

mu_p_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the growth inhibition mean predictor.

mu_p_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the growth inhibition mean predictor.

omega_p_intercept_prior

(Prior) Prior for the intercept of the growth inhibition standard deviation predictor.

omega_p_coefficients_prior

(Prior) Prior for the covariate coefficients of the growth inhibition standard deviation predictor.

sigma

(Prior) Observation-error standard deviation prior.

scaled_variance

(logical) Whether to use multiplicative observation error.

centred_baseline

(logical) Whether to use centred parameterizations.

centred_growth

(logical) Whether to use centred parameterizations.

centred_resistance

(logical) Whether to use centred parameterizations.

centred_inhibition

(logical) Whether to use centred parameterizations.

Value

A LongitudinalClaretBrunoCov object.
